items.name: craftui-base
items.title: CraftUI Base
items.description: Core dependencies for CraftUI — framer-motion and motion.

items.name: trash-default
items.title: Trash Icon - Default
items.description: Shake animation during delete operation

items.name: trash-shake
items.title: Trash Icon - Lid Lift
items.description: Lid lifts and bounces during delete operation

items.name: trash-bounce
items.title: Trash Icon - Fill & Crush
items.description: Lines fill up and trash compresses during delete operation

items.name: trash-dissolve
items.title: Trash Icon - Dissolve Up
items.description: Paths dissolve upward sequentially like smoke during delete operation

items.name: tab-open-default
items.title: Tab Open Icon - Default
items.description: On hover, the dark tab slides up, the base slides down, and the triangle arrow pops up between them creating an opening effect

items.name: shopping-cart-default
items.title: Shopping Cart Icon - Default
items.description: Item falls into cart from above and cart shakes when adding to cart

items.name: refresh-default
items.title: Refresh Icon - Default
items.description: Click the button to see the refresh icon in action.

items.name: refresh-stroke
items.title: Refresh Icon - Stroke Drawing
items.description: Circular stroke drawing effect

items.name: refresh-dash
items.title: Refresh Icon - Traveling Dash
items.description: Dashed segments travel along the path

items.name: msg-glass-typing
items.title: Messages Icon - Typing Indicator
items.description: Front bubble bounces gently up and down to indicate someone is typing. Perfect for real-time chat applications.

items.name: msg-glass-wiggle
items.title: Messages Icon - Wiggle
items.description: Entire icon rotates gently (±5°) on hover. Great for unread message indicators or clickable chat buttons.

items.name: msg-glass-slideIn
items.title: Messages Icon - Slide In
items.description: Bubbles slide in from opposite sides with spring bounce. Perfect for chat interface loading or conversation opening.

items.name: mail-default
items.title: Mail Icon - Default
items.description: Envelope flap opens on hover to reveal mail inside

items.name: mail-notification
items.title: Mail Icon - Notification Badge
items.description: Icon bounces and shows glowing ping indicator when new mail arrives

items.name: lock-glass-default
items.title: Lock Icon - Show Password
items.description: For password visibility toggles - shackle slides up-right and body slides down-left when password is visible (unlocked state)

items.name: lock-glass-unlock
items.title: Lock Icon - Unlock
items.description: For premium content unlock or access granted states - shackle lifts upward and rotates 90° in 3D with right side as hinge, body scales slightly

items.name: layout-default
items.title: Layout Dashboard Icon - Default
items.description: On hover, the two filled panels swap to the opposite two panels

items.name: layout-swap
items.title: Layout Dashboard Icon - Swap
items.description: On hover, the filled boxes physically morph and travel to take the position and shape of the empty boxes

items.name: home-default
items.title: Home Icon - Default
items.description: Click the icon to toggle the selected state. The icon will animate to indicate selection.

items.name: home-draw
items.title: Home Icon - Sketch Reveal
items.description: Stroke animation draws the house from foundation to roof during loading

items.name: external-link-default
items.title: External Link Icon - Default
items.description: On hover, the box fills with color and the arrow bounces diagonally up-right along its direction, then returns

items.name: download-default
items.title: Download Icon - Bounce
items.description: Arrow translates down into the tray and snaps back on click

items.name: calendar-page-flip
items.title: Calendar Icon - Page Flip
items.description: Calendar body rotates in 3D along the top edge like flipping a physical calendar page. Header with binding rings stays fixed. Perfect for month navigation.

items.name: calendar-picker-open
items.title: Calendar Icon - Picker Open
items.description: Calendar body splits and opens like a book on hover. Left half slides left, right half slides right. Perfect for date picker buttons that open calendars.

items.name: calendar-slide-month
items.title: Calendar Icon - Slide Month Change
items.description: Date dots slide out to the left and new dots slide in from the right when month changes. Calendar body and header stay fixed.

items.name: bulb-default
items.title: Bulb Icon - Default
items.description: Bulb fills and rays appear on hover to indicate ideas/tips

items.name: alarm-clock-default
items.title: Alarm Icon - Ring
items.description: The alarm rocks left and right like a ringing bell, with ears counter-rotating to sell the physics

items.name: alarm-clock-tick
items.title: Alarm Icon - Tick
items.description: The clock hand sweeps a full clockwise rotation on click, like dialing an alarm to confirm it's set

items.name: triangle-cascade-default
items.title: Triangle Cascade - Triangle Cascade
items.description: Five horizontal bars slide into position one after another, filling a triangle shape from bottom to top in a waterfall effect

items.name: square-flip-default
items.title: Square Flip - Square Flip
items.description: A rectangle collapses to a thin line then expands back, simulating a 3D Y-axis flip animation

items.name: square-corners-rotate-default
items.title: Square Corners Rotate - Square Corners Rotate
items.description: Four 90-degree arc segments at the corners of a square expand and contract while rotating 360° with bouncy easing

items.name: square-corners-dance-default
items.title: Square Corners Dance - Square Corners Dance
items.description: Four squares at the corners of a bounding box shift positions clockwise, creating a spinning dance animation

items.name: spinner-orbit-dots-default
items.title: Spinner Orbit Dots - Spinner Orbit Dots
items.description: Dots arranged in a radial pattern rotate together as a group, with opacity gradient creating a comet-tail effect

items.name: siri-wave-default
items.title: Siri Wave - Siri Wave
items.description: Center bar tallest, outer bars shortest — all oscillate with staggered delays creating a smooth symmetric wave that pulses outward from center

items.name: scan-line-default
items.title: Scan Line - Scan Line
items.description: A glowing gradient segment — bright at the leading edge, fading behind — sweeps across a faint track and resets

items.name: pulse-ring-default
items.title: Pulse Ring - Pulse Ring
items.description: Staggered rings emanate from the center, scaling up and fading out like ripples on water

items.name: ios-spinner-trail-default
items.title: iOS Spinner Trail - Sharp Trail
items.description: Exponential opacity decay — only 4-5 spokes are visibly bright, the rest vanish sharply, creating an intense laser comet

items.name: ios-spinner-thick-default
items.title: iOS Spinner Thick - Thick
items.description: 8 wide pill-shaped spokes at 45° apart — bold and graphic, great for large-screen or kiosk UIs

items.name: ios-spinner-pulse-default
items.title: iOS Spinner Pulse - Pulse
items.description: Each spoke flashes bright in sequence — no group rotation, the glow steps discretely around the clock

items.name: ios-spinner-grow-default
items.title: iOS Spinner Grow - Grow
items.description: Each spoke shoots outward radially as it activates — a blooming radial extension effect

items.name: ios-spinner-dual-default
items.title: iOS Spinner Dual - Dual Ring
items.description: Outer ring of 12 spokes clockwise, inner ring of 8 spokes counter-clockwise — gyroscope effect

items.name: ios-spinner-dots-default
items.title: iOS Spinner Dots - Dots
items.description: 12 circles on an orbit ring with comet-tail opacity — same mechanic as classic, rounder feel

items.name: ios-spinner-default
items.title: iOS Spinner - Classic
items.description: 12 rounded spokes with linear opacity comet tail — the exact macOS connecting spinner

items.name: infinity-loop-default
items.title: Infinity Loop - Infinity Loop
items.description: A dot traces the mathematical lemniscate (infinity symbol) path smoothly and continuously

items.name: hexagon-rotate-default
items.title: Hexagon Rotate - Hexagon Rotate
items.description: A hexagon outline or filled shape rotates 360° continuously with smooth linear motion

items.name: heart-fill-default
items.title: Heart Fill - Heart Fill
items.description: Heart shape waits nearly empty then rapidly fills with color in a dramatic pulse, looping like a heartbeat

items.name: grid-wave-row-default
items.title: Grid Wave Row - Grid Wave Row
items.description: Each row sweeps left to right in sequence, creating a horizontal wave that cascades downward

items.name: grid-spiral-default
items.title: Grid Spiral - Grid Spiral
items.description: Dots activate in a clockwise spiral — outer ring first (top-left → top → right → bottom → left), center last

items.name: grid-snake-default
items.title: Grid Snake - Grid Snake
items.description: Dots activate in a boustrophedon (back-and-forth) path that slithers through all 9 positions

items.name: grid-ripple-default
items.title: Grid Ripple - Grid Ripple
items.description: Center dot fires first, then the 4 adjacent edges, then the 4 corners — concentric expansion outward

items.name: grid-random-default
items.title: Grid Random - Grid Random
items.description: Dots activate in a fixed but non-sequential order that reads as random — like a matrix initialising

items.name: grid-pulse-default
items.title: Grid Pulse - Grid Pulse
items.description: Nine dots arranged in a 3×3 grid light up and fade in a rolling diagonal wave, top-left to bottom-right

items.name: grid-cross-default
items.title: Grid Cross - Grid Cross
items.description: The 5 cross-shaped dots (center row + center column) pulse first, then the 4 corner dots follow — two-phase alternation

items.name: grid-corners-in-default
items.title: Grid Corners In - Grid Corners In
items.description: The 4 corner dots pulse first, then the 4 edge-center dots, then the center — an inward collapse opposite to ripple

items.name: grid-column-scan-default
items.title: Grid Column Scan - Grid Column Scan
items.description: A full column of dots lights up simultaneously, sweeping left to right like a vertical scan bar

items.name: grid-clock-default
items.title: Grid Clock - Grid Clock
items.description: Dots sweep clockwise from top-center (12 o'clock) through all 8 outer positions, then the center fires last

items.name: grid-checker-default
items.title: Grid Checker - Grid Checker
items.description: 5 dots on even positions and 4 dots on odd positions pulse half a cycle apart, creating a flickering checkerboard

items.name: fill-water-drop-default
items.title: Water Drop - Water Drop
items.description: An outlined droplet fills bottom to top with an undulating water wave

items.name: fill-thermometer-default
items.title: Thermometer - Thermometer
items.description: An outlined thermometer with a mercury column that rises from the bulb to the top in a loop

items.name: fill-paint-bucket-default
items.title: Paint Bucket - Paint Bucket
items.description: A stream of paint pours into an outlined bucket while the level inside rises, then fades and repeats

items.name: fill-hourglass-default
items.title: Hourglass - Hourglass
items.description: Sand streams from the top bulb into the bottom one, then the hourglass rotates 180 degrees and drains again

items.name: fill-flask-default
items.title: Flask - Flask
items.description: An outlined lab flask holds liquid while staggered bubbles rise and pop at the surface

items.name: fill-coffee-cup-default
items.title: Coffee Cup - Coffee Cup
items.description: An outlined coffee cup where two layered waves of liquid slosh continuously at a constant level

items.name: fill-beer-glass-default
items.title: Beer Glass - Beer Glass
items.description: An outlined beer mug fills with amber liquid while a bubbly foam cap rises on top

items.name: fill-battery-default
items.title: Battery - Battery
items.description: An outlined battery charges up as the level sweeps from empty to full in a loop

items.name: download-bounce-default
items.title: Download Bounce - Download Bounce
items.description: Arrow continuously bounces down into the tray while download is in progress

items.name: dots-rotate-default
items.title: Dots Rotate - Dots Rotate
items.description: Three circular dots that continuously rotate 120 degrees around a center point

items.name: dots-compress-default
items.title: Dots Compress - Dots Compress
items.description: Three dots alternating between horizontal spread and vertical stack with container morphing

items.name: dots-bounce-default
items.title: Dots Bounce - Dots Bounce
items.description: Dots in a horizontal row bounce upward sequentially with staggered delays creating a wave-like typing indicator

items.name: dot-matrix-vortex-default
items.title: Dot Matrix Vortex - Dot Matrix Vortex
items.description: Each concentric ring has one bright active dot that travels its perimeter. Inner rings spin at 2×, 4×, 8× the speed of the outer ring, creating a constantly-changing phase relationship between rings.

items.name: dot-matrix-rain-default
items.title: Dot Matrix Rain - Dot Matrix Rain
items.description: Each column runs an independent drop cycle. A bright head falls from top to bottom with a trailing glow, then pauses before the next drop begins.

items.name: dot-matrix-life-default
items.title: Dot Matrix Life - Dot Matrix Life
items.description: Each generation, every dot lives or dies based on its 8 neighbours following Conway's rules. Seeded with multiple blinker oscillators that interact across the toroidal grid.

items.name: dot-matrix-chase-default
items.title: Dot Matrix Chase - Dot Matrix Chase
items.description: A bright leader and dimmer chaser travel the same spiral path 55% of its length apart. Their interlocking tails create a kinetic, predator-prey visual.

items.name: dot-matrix-bits-default
items.title: Dot Matrix Bits - Dot Matrix Bits
items.description: Each row is an independent binary counter at a different speed. The bottom row flips every tick; the top row changes rarely. Every dot can be in a unique state.

items.name: dot-circle-expand-default
items.title: Dot Circle Expand - Dot Circle Expand
items.description: Static center dot with four corner dots that pulse outward and return, creating a dynamic radial expansion effect

items.name: dock-bounce-default
items.title: Dock Bounce - Dock Bounce
items.description: App icon shoots up, squashes on landing with scaleX/scaleY, decays through two secondary bounces, then pauses before repeating

items.name: cross-expand-default
items.title: Cross Expand - Cross Expand
items.description: Static center cross with four corner squares that expand outward, rotate 90°, then retract in a pulsing geometric pattern

items.name: conic-spinner-default
items.title: Conic Spinner - Conic Spinner
items.description: Circular pie-style loader that fills clockwise from 0° to 360° in 8 equal steps over 2 seconds

items.name: circular-wave-fill-default
items.title: Circular Wave Fill - Circular Wave Fill
items.description: A circle fills with a flowing wave animation, the color rises from bottom to top with undulating motion

items.name: circle-spinner-wipe-default
items.title: Circle Spinner Wipe - Circle Spinner Wipe
items.description: Two concentric rings where the foreground ring wipes clockwise from 0% to 100% over the background track

items.name: breath-default
items.title: Breath - Breath
items.description: A filled circle inhales and exhales with a trailing outer glow ring — inspired by the MacBook sleep indicator LED

items.name: bars-wave-default
items.title: Bars Wave - Bars Wave
items.description: Five vertical bars with staggered height animation creating a wave effect

items.name: bars-scale-wave-default
items.title: Bars Scale Wave - Bars Scale Wave
items.description: Vertical bars grow and shrink in a wave pattern with staggered delays, resembling an audio equalizer

items.name: bars-scale-bottom-default
items.title: Bars Scale Bottom - Bars Scale Bottom
items.description: Three vertical bars scaling up and down with bottom fixed

items.name: bars-scale-01-scale
items.title: Bars Scale - Bars Scale
items.description: Three vertical bars scaling up and down with sequential animation

items.name: bars-pulse-swap-default
items.title: Bars Pulse Swap - Bars Pulse Swap
items.description: Six bars arranged in three pairs that continuously pulse while swapping between stacked and overlapped positions

items.name: bars-fill-sequential-default
items.title: Bars Fill Sequential - Bars Fill Sequential
items.description: Three bars that rise from bottom to top in sequence, creating a wave effect

items.name: bars-fade-01-fade
items.title: Bars Fade - Bars Fade
items.description: Three vertical bars with smooth fade animation

items.name: bars-cascade-default
items.title: Bars Cascade - Bars Cascade
items.description: Four horizontal bars with stripe pattern that cascade down from top, stack up, then cascade out from bottom

items.name: bars-bounce-default
items.title: Bars Bounce - Bars Bounce
items.description: Three bars that synchronously change height while bouncing between top and bottom positions

items.name: ball-bounce-slide-default
items.title: Ball Bounce Slide - Ball Bounce Slide
items.description: A ball with extreme bounce easing slides horizontally across a ground line, creating a dynamic rolling/bouncing motion

items.name: ball-bounce-dashed-default
items.title: Ball Bounce Dashed - Ball Bounce Dashed
items.description: Ball stays centered and bounces in place while a dashed ground line scrolls underneath, creating the illusion of motion

items.name: ball-bounce-box-default
items.title: Ball Bounce Box - Ball Bounce Box
items.description: A square box outline rotates 90° in stepped intervals while a ball bounces rapidly inside it

items.name: ball-bounce-alternate-default
items.title: Ball Bounce Alternate - Ball Bounce Alternate
items.description: A ball slides left to right then reverses direction, bouncing on the ground line creating a pendulum-like motion

items.name: audio-wave-vertical-default
items.title: Audio Wave Vertical - Audio Wave Vertical
items.description: Five vertical bars animating in a symmetric wave pattern like audio visualization

items.name: audio-bars-sequential-default
items.title: Audio Bars Sequential - Audio Bars Sequential
items.description: Six vertical bars with sequential wave animation traveling from left to right

items.name: audio-bars-opacity-default
items.title: Audio Bars Opacity - Audio Bars Opacity
items.description: Six vertical bars fading in and out as they grow and shrink, creating a ghosting wave effect

items.name: audio-bars-horizontal-default
items.title: Audio Bars Sync - Audio Bars Sync
items.description: Six vertical bars with perfectly synchronized alternating heights creating a rhythmic wave

items.name: audio-bars-glow-default
items.title: Audio Bars Glow - Audio Bars Glow
items.description: Six vertical bars with gradient fill, glow effect, and synchronized alternating animation

items.name: app-download-default
items.title: App Download - App Download
items.description: A rounded arc sweeps around a faint track using strokeDashoffset animation, with a brief pause between each full rotation

items.name: activity-rings-default
items.title: Activity Rings - Activity Rings
items.description: Three nested arcs (75% visible) rotate at different speeds — outer slowest, inner fastest — with decreasing opacity inward

items.name: travel-card-default
items.title: Travel Card - Travel Card
items.description: The image, background color, CTA button, and a badge icon all animate between a cover-photo stage and a detail stage with price and tags, connected by an icon that flies along a curved path between the two.

items.name: theme-button-default
items.title: Theme Button - Theme Button
items.description: Collapsed status pill morphs into an expanded font or theme list via a shared layoutId spring, with a blur cross-fade on the inner content. Themes/fonts, selection, and change callbacks are all props. Includes an inlined iOS pulse spinner so the block ships self-contained.

items.name: teletype-clock-default
items.title: Teletype Clock - Split-Flap Clock
items.description: Four HH:MM digit cards. On change, the old digit's top half hinges down on the center seam (ease-in free fall), then the new digit's bottom half swings into place with an overshoot-and-settle bounce. Shading overlays darken the falling flap and light up the landing one for a 3D feel.

items.name: subitem-navbar-subitem-navbar
items.title: SubItem Navbar - SubItem Navbar
items.description: Tabs expand a panel above the bar via a spring-driven height animation. Panels are either a chip filter list (subs) or any React node (panel). LoginPanel is a named export for use as a panel slot.

items.name: profile-card-navbar
items.title: Profile Card - Navbar
items.description: Small avatar in a phone frame expands via layoutId into a floating profile card with staggered menu groups.

items.name: product-card-default
items.title: Product Card - Product Card
items.description: Three photos morph from an overlapping stacked deck into an evenly spaced fan, while the CTA morphs from a small gallery icon into a full-width action button and the price/description/tags fade in.

items.name: pixel-dissolve-card-default
items.title: Pixel Dissolve Card - Pixel Dissolve Card
items.description: Clicking the card swaps the image underneath instantly, then dissolves the outgoing photo away as a size × size grid of tiles. Each tile is a background-position slice of the same image, and tiles are assigned to random groups so they vanish in scattered clusters instead of sweeping row by row.

items.name: onboarding-form-default
items.title: Onboarding Form - Onboarding Form
items.description: Multi-step onboarding form with a vertical ticker step indicator on the left and an animated question panel on the right, covering five field types: radio, dropdown, multi-select, short text and long text.

items.name: morphing-image-effect-default
items.title: Morphing Image Effect - Image Morph
items.description: Three-stage morph: thumbnail pill → landscape card → portrait card. Text scales inversely as the image grows.

items.name: frosted-navbar-frosted-navbar
items.title: Frosted Navbar - Frosted Navbar
items.description: No hardcoded height or width: the bar sizes to its content and its parent's width, so it drops into any layout as a <nav> or <header>. The blur layer extends past the nav's own edge for clean filter sampling, then gets clipped by overflow-hidden so it never bleeds into content below.

items.name: contact-reveal-card-default
items.title: Contact Reveal Card - Contact Reveal Card
items.description: Hovering an icon previews which slice of the identity string it maps to; clicking commits the selection so it also works on touch. The highlighted span and its dashed underline animate width/position with a layout spring, the caption crossfades, and the icon row's hover-dim effect is pure CSS via :has/:not/:hover.

items.name: checkout-button-default
items.title: Check out Button - Check out Button
items.description: A compact trigger button that morphs into a checkout card with tabbed payment methods (QR, card, Apple Pay, Amazon Pay) and a connect-wallet screen, all sharing one layout shell.

items.name: category-ticker-vertical-marquee
items.title: Vertical Marquee - Vertical Marquee
items.description: Auto-scrolling vertical word ticker with kinetic typography. A fixed arrow pointer highlights the active item as the list cycles on a timed interval.

items.name: avatar-default
items.title: Avatar Grid - Avatar Grid
items.description: A team cluster laid out on a hatched placeholder grid — avatars sit in fixed cells around a centre brand mark under a circular fade, and hovering one lifts it out of the grid and restores its colour.

items.name: ai-chat-default
items.title: AI Chat - AI Chat
items.description: A theme-token-driven AI prompt composer. Mode and model pickers morph between a collapsed pill and an expanded panel through a shared layoutId spring with a blur cross-fade; the plus button fans out a radial attachment menu; tool chips reveal with a staggered cross-blur; the mic cross-fades to an animated waveform while a typewriter transcript slides in. Attachments, tools, modes, models, and transcript phrases are all props, with controlled/uncontrolled selection per dimension. The pickers ship as full APG menus (roving tabindex, arrow-key navigation, focus restore), every control carries an accessible name, closed reveals are inert, the transcript announces through an aria-live region, and all motion honors prefers-reduced-motion.

items.name: team-cluster-01-default
items.title: Team Cluster 01 - Team Cluster 01
items.description: A team section built around the avatar cluster. Perfet to use to showcase your team details in a website.

items.name: feature-gallery-02-default
items.title: Feature Gallery 02 - Feature Gallery 02
items.description: Five travel destinations revealed through a sticky scroll. The right panel stacks images in a weighted parallax strip; the left panel slides in destination info driven by scroll position.

items.name: feature-gallery-01-default
items.title: Feature Gallery 01 - Feature Gallery 01
items.description: Cards rise into place on scroll, then the clicked card widens around a stationary image while the rest narrow. Heights never change; the label and scrim fade in last.

items.name: otp-input-ripple
items.title: OTP Input - Ripple
items.description: Each box wears an SVG outline that behaves like a liquid surface — typing nudges it, moving to the next box hands the ripple off toward its right edge. Pass a validate function and the component choreographs the pending ring, the staggered success wave and the red shake by itself, then calls your onSuccess / onFailure.

items.name: button-whimsical
items.title: Button - Whimsical
items.description: On hover or focus, five color-shifted sparkle particles launch along the button's border via CSS offset-path, each with its own speed, scale and landing spot.

items.name: button-confetti
items.title: Button - Confetti Burst
items.description: On click, a burst of color-varied confetti pieces launches from the button center — each with its own angle, distance and rotation — arcing up and falling back down under simulated gravity.

items.name: button-scramble
items.title: Button - Scramble Text
items.description: On hover or focus, the label's characters cycle rapidly through random glyphs before locking in to the real text one character at a time, left to right — a decode-style reveal built entirely from content substitution, no positional or color motion.

items.name: accordion-clip
items.title: Accordion - Clip
items.description: Two-layer card reveal — the question clips away via clip-path in the chosen direction, exposing the answer beneath. Click the answer to return.

items.name: accordion-drawer
items.title: Accordion - Drawer
items.description: Each trigger lifts with a 3D spring when open, and the content slides up from behind it. Spring stiffness and damping are fully configurable via the DialKit panel.

items.name: accordion-ease
items.title: Accordion - Ease
items.description: Content panel opens and closes with a cubic-bezier easing curve. Use the DialKit easing editor to draw any curve — ease-out, ease-in-out, or a custom bezier.
